description: Machine-readable door clearance provisions. Citations are illustrative paraphrases in the style of NBC 2020 3.8.3.12 accessible door requirements; they are NOT legal text.

citation.text: Doorways in an accessible path of travel shall provide a clear width of not less than 850 mm when the door is in the open position.

rules.verdictSemantics: pass when the declared OverallWidth attribute meets the minimum; fail when below; inconclusive when the attribute is unset.

citation.text: The clear width of an accessible doorway shall be measured between the face of the open door leaf and the opposite stop.

rules.verdictSemantics: pass/fail against the authored clear-width property; inconclusive when the model does not carry Pset_DoorCommon.ClearWidth (the checker refuses to guess a true clear width from leaf width).

citation.text: Declared door dimensions relied on for compliance shall agree with the constructed (measured) door size.

rules.verdictSemantics: pass when the measured leaf width agrees with the declared OverallWidth within tolerance; fail on disagreement; inconclusive when either value is unavailable.

citation.text: A clear and level area shall be provided on the latch side and in front of an accessible door, unobstructed by fixed furnishings, sufficient for a wheelchair to approach and operate the door.

rules.verdictSemantics: pass when no furnishing element origin falls inside the clearance zone box (door footprint expanded by one door width); fail when one does; not_applicable outside the storey filter; inconclusive when the door placement cannot be resolved.
